latest.title: Supercharged Workflow & High-Scale Data
latest.summary: Major upgrades including Saved Query Folders, Direct Streaming Export (>10,000 rows), Realtime Execution Monitoring, and Collapsible Results.

highlights.title: Saved Query Folders & Drag-and-Drop
highlights.description: Organize your SQL queries into custom folders with quick actions, folder context menus, and drag-and-drop support.

highlights.title: Direct Streaming Export (>10,000 rows)
highlights.description: Stream unlimited query results directly to disk in CSV (with Excel BOM), JSON, TSV, or JSONL with zero memory bloat.

highlights.title: Realtime Execution Loader & Cancel
highlights.description: Live elapsed timer, animated query progress indicator, and instant cancellation keep query execution responsive without stale states.

highlights.title: Collapsible Results Panel (⌘J)
highlights.description: Toggle the bottom query results view on demand via ⌘J shortcut or toolbar button to maximize your SQL editor workspace.

highlights.title: Safe Inline Table Updates
highlights.description: Primary key projection validation prevents invalid UPDATE queries, protecting against silent update errors and data corruption.
